investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: A delete operation was initiated against the production virtual network vnet-tallinn-prod-01 by margus.tamm@eestitehnika.ee. The actor is identified as a Cloud Infrastructure Administrator and the activity originated from an Estonian IP (Tallinn) at 16:12 local time, which is within normal working hours. There is no request_body available for rule-delta analysis and no recent correlated events or similar alerts; given the legitimate admin role, expected geolocation, and timing, this is classified as Low Priority (LP).
